275581067.description:
Rough and Polished Mineral Specimen Lot
Mixed Natural Stones
9.48 lbs
This substantial 9.48-pound collection features a diverse array of mineral specimens, ranging from raw, unrefined geodes to polished gemstones and cabochons. The lot includes a notable selection of quartz crystal clusters and points, bladed blue kyanite, and vibrant banded malachite. Ideal for collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, or as educational samples, the variety encompasses multiple geological formations and mineral species.
Mineral variety includes quartz, kyanite, malachite, amethyst, and jasper
Features rough geode pieces, polished tumbled stones, and one fossil specimen
Contains approximately 9.48 lbs of mixed material as shown in photos
Includes various textures from crystalline clusters to smooth river-worn surfaces
Condition:
Very good overall condition. The lot consists of natural stones and mineral specimens in their characteristic rough or polished states. Crystalline structures, such as the quartz points, appear largely intact with expected natural inclusions and edge wear. Polished stones show consistent surface finishes. Natural variations in color, shape, and internal fracturing are present across the collection as is typical for geological samples.
